note: getDeflects = function(self, t, fake) if fake or self:hasDualWeapon() then return self:combatStatScale("cun", 1, 2.25) else return 0 end end; info 第2个参数 %0.1f = t.getDeflects(self, t, true) -> combatStatScale("cun",1,2.25) 展开为 combatScale(cun, 1, 10, 2.25, 100)

getDeflects = function(self, t, fake) if fake or self:hasDualWeapon() then return self:combatStatScale("cun", 2, 3) + (not fake and self:hasEffect(self.EFF_FEINT) and 1 or 0) else return 0 end end; info 第2个参数 %0.1f = t.getDeflects(self, t, true)，fake=true 故无 FEINT 加成 -> combatStatScale("cun",2,3) 展开为 combatScale(cun, 2, 10, 3, 100)
